text:
What is machine learning (ML)? What can an ML model do when trained properly by a scientist?

Machine learning (ML) is a way for computers to learn patterns from examples humans have identified and use those patterns to analyze new data.

In this lesson, you will use a ML model to identify earthquakes in the same data you looked at yesterday. First, let's find an earthquake signal in the data to see how it works.

Instructions

1) In the WaveRunner Tile, choose any station around Anchorage.

2) Set the "Model" dropdown to "Compact model"

3) Set the start date as November 29, 2018 at 12:00 am

4) Set the end date as December 1, 2018 at 12:00 am

5) Click the “Run model" button in the bottom control bar of the Wave Runner 1 tile.

6) Click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar.

7) Scroll down to see the event timeline.

8) Explore the labeled earthquake events in the Timeline tile.
